verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v1: baynī wabaynaka yā ḍarīḥa l-ʾamjadi ʿahdu yasīru ʿalā ṭarīqi tajaddudi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v2: falaʾin naʾaytu fakālkhayāli tazūrunī walaʾin ʾataytu faraghbatī fī l-mashhadi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v3: ʾinna l-basīṭata fī takāthuri ʾahlihā qullu waʾinna dharāka ʾawsaʿu mawridi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v4: hadhā n-nasīmu wamā bihi min riqqahi liz-zāʾirīna wamā bihi lil-ʿubbadi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v5: fakaʾannahu misku yafūḥu biṭībihi wakaʾannahu naddu biẓilli tabarrudi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v6: hadhā l-hudūʾu wamā bihi min ḥikmahi ʾinna l-hudūʾa laḥikmahu lil-muhtadī
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v7: ʾila fuʾādā bayna bahjahi dhikrihi yaḥnū wabayna bukāʾihi litawaddudi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v8: ʾila ʾaṣābiʿa qāriʾi fī subḥahi tatawāradu l-ḥabbātu minhā lil-yadi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v9: ʾila rajāʾa l-muʾuminīna biquṭbihim ʾila l-mujāwira fī ntiẓāri sarmadī
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v1: ʿajabā limaʿnā l-kāʾināti wasirrihā ʿajabā likulli ḥaqīqati lam tujḥadi
ʿajabā liyawmi qad raʾaytuka musdala fī ḥufrati ʿajabā libaḥri mulḥadi
fanasītu ḥattā l-wājibāti muhayyamā waʾabaytu ḥattā l-ḥaqqa mithla mufannidi
walamastu jismī bit-taḥḥasusi fāghtadā jismī madhāba taʾallumi watawajjudi
wanaẓartu wad-dunyā ʾamāmī mā bihā ʾarḍu wala shajaru wala shayʾu budī
ʾila ḍarīḥuka waḍ-ḍarīḥu likullinā ḥaramu waʾamnu ḍidda muʾudhi muʿtadi
ʾinna lladhī jaʿala l-khilafata manṣibā jaʿala ḍ-ḍarīḥa lanā qarīna l-masjidi
waʾaqāma baynahumā hudā waṣiyānata waʾatamma ḥawlahumā ʾamānī l-wurradi
waʾaṭāba taḥtahumā l-ḥayāta kaʾannamā baʿḍu l-ḥayāti ladayhimā fī l-ʾasʿadi
wahali l-ḥayātu liʿāqili walifāhimi ʾila l-ḥaqāʾiqu la t-taʿʿamuqu fī dadi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v2: mā fī bayāḍi r-raʾasi baʿda sawādihi fī fatrati ʾila nadhīru bil-ghadi
mā baʿda ḥusni qiwāmihi fī qawmihi ʾila nḥināʾu ẓ-ẓahri waḍ-ḍuʿfu r-radī
wal-bāqiyātu ṣ-ṣāliḥātu biʿaynihā khayru wafīhā zādu kulli muzawwidi
wamaqāmuhā fīnā wamarkazu nūrihā ḥawla ḍ-ḍarīḥi bifaḍli shaykhi ʾawḥadi
waʾarāka ʾalṭafa lir-rijāli mina l-hanā waʾarāka ʾanfaʿa lil-ʾamānī min yadi
tughnī l-jalīsa ʿani lladhīdhi mina ṭ-ṭuhā waʿani l-muthallaji min sharābi ṣarkhadī
fakaʾanna ʾarwāḥa ṭ-ṭawāʾifi kullahā raḍiyat biʾamrika fī libāsi tajannudi
jahila t-taʿʿaṣuba ʾahlu ḥaḍratika l-ʾulā mā bāyaʿū ʾila lʾajli muḥammadi
ʾila likawnika mufradā fī ʿaṣrihi walikawni ʿaṣrika ṭawʿa ʾamri l-mufradi
fataʿāhadū ʾan la wasīlata baʿda man wajadūhu khatmā lil-ʿulā was-suʾudadi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v3: wataʿʿahadū lidharāka ʾidh ʾalifū bihā ʾalfā mina l-khayrāti kulla taʿʿahudi
wataḥḥamalū thiqala l-hidāyati bir-riḍā watajalladū fī s-saʿyī khayra tajalludi
waʿalayhi tattafiqu d-dawāʾiru mabdaʾa min baʿḍi mā warithū wabaʿḍi takhalludi
ʿan qawli kulli muʿāriḍi ʾaw munkiri ʿan kaydi kulli muʿānidi ʿan ḥussadi
hajarūhumu hajrā jamīla mā bihim ʾila ʾakhū sharafi karīmu l-maḥtidi
ʾayna th-thaqāfatu baʿdu ʾakrim billadhī min shaʾanihi taʿlīqu kulli mujalladi
ʾayna r-razānatu baʿdu ʾakrim billadhī ʾasnā mina l-badri l-munīri ʿalā n-nadī
ʾayna l-futuwwatu baʿdu ʾakrim billadhī ʾasadu ʾamāma mumajjasi wamuhawwadi
ʾayna l-marūʾatu baʿdu ʾakrim billadhī fī nafsihi maliku yuzāru bimaʿbadi
hadhā ʾabū bakri bibaʿḍi ṣifātihi hadhā ḍarīḥu ʾabī l-ḥabībi ṣ-ṣindidi
verses.bayni-wabaynaka-ya-dariha-l-amjadi-c1-v4: baynā ʾazūruka ʾidh ʾatatnī nafḥahu baynī wabaynaka yā ḍarīḥa l-ʾamjadi
